parsed.rationale_overall: Both systems produce very similar, well-personalized and risk-aligned recommendations, but System A provides more precise dollar-figure actions and grounded calculations (e.g., correct 19-month cash cushion, specific $96k redeployment). System B contains a minor factual slip (claiming $120k in cash equals 2.4 years of expenses when it is ~2.4 years only roughly, and suggesting MUB municipal bonds for a $78k income retiree where tax advantage is marginal), giving A a slight edge on grounding and actionability.
